58eab1f7.text:
REPORT: Thieves

More alarming than the kobolds, a $r gang of thieves has emerged in the valley.  They wear red bandanas and call themselves a brotherhood.  This level of organization may lead to trouble, both here and in all of Elwynn Forest.

We have identified one of their leaders--one Garrick Padfoot--and hope to bring him to justice soon.
58eab1f7.title: Marshal McBride's Documents

6457faf4.text:
Hello Morgan,

Business in Goldshire is brisk, so brisk that I haven't had time to send you any shipments!  

I commissioned the person bearing this note to bring you a package of large wax candles (you know, the ones the Kobolds like to wear on their heads?). 

Please give this person our thanks, and fair payment.
6457faf4.title: William's Shipment

685ca9c0.text:
Too often people like the followers of the Holy Light scare those curious about true power into thinking they cannot investigate any form of the arcane--not all things from outside this world are evil. Not all entities seek to dominate or subjugate others. If you are powerful enough, those same entities can become the followers.

This is something I would like to discuss more with you. Seek me out in the graveyard on the right side of the abbey.

-Drusilla La Salle, $C Trainer
685ca9c0.title: Tainted Letter

7965fa2d.text:
COMMENDATION:

The bearer of these documents is to be awarded Deputy status with the Stormwind Army, having served Northshire with eagerness and distinction.  I am confident you will find this person useful in Elwynn Forest.

signed:
-Marshal Douglas McBride, 
Stormwind Army, Northshire
7965fa2d.title: Marshal McBride's Documents

aec44f20.text:
REPORT: Wolves

There has been an increase in reported animal attacks in Northshire.  Eagan believes the  wolves in the valley were scared here from Duskwood.

Although the wolves rarely hunt $r prey, the sheer number of them has caused some incidents with farmers.  And many livestock have gone missing.
aec44f20.title: Marshal McBride's Documents

c562b99e.text:
REPORT: Kobolds

The activity of kobolds has increased in the vicinity of Northshire Valley.  They camp north of the abbey and within the Echo Ridge Mine in alarming numbers.  I have marshalled paladins, warriors and other local folk to aid me in ridding us of the vermin.

This progresses well.  And I will update as needed.
c562b99e.title: Marshal McBride's Documents

1305|9f005af4.name: Jarel Moor
1305|9f005af4.text: Take my advice, don't sit close to the shadows.

1430|0c543544.name: Tomas
1430|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1430|b48f927f.name: Tomas
1430|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

1632|fee38227.name: Adele Fielder
1632|fee38227.text: Since my husband left for the front, Helene here has been my strength. Her kind heart and sharp sword have helped me through a lot of tough times. I don't know what I would've done without her.

1651|c2467ddc.name: Lee Brown
1651|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

197|877c25a9.name: Marshal McBride
197|877c25a9.text: Hey, citizen!  You look like a stout one.  We guards are spread a little thin out here, and I could use your help...

240|3ccc4430.name: Marshal Dughan
240|3ccc4430.text: Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up! I hope you have good news, $N...

241|2823b3ed.name: Remy "Two Times"
241|2823b3ed.text: Hey there, friend.  My name's Remy.  I'm from Redridge to the east, and came here looking for business, looking for business.  You got any...got any??

247226|58a0ba23.name: Kelsey Fargo
247226|58a0ba23.text: Blast these kobolds. I can't get any work done with them running back and forth, getting in my way. Well, I've got nothing better to do. Would you like to learn about mining techniques? Or perhaps you just need some new tools?

247227|0371bf6f.name: Riley Peltskinner
247227|0371bf6f.text: Care to learn how to gather leather from slain beasts? Or do you need some new tools?

247229|55b52cc4.name: Daniel
247229|55b52cc4.text: What does Brother Paxton need now?

248415|bdfaa98c.name: Tordrin Sternblade
248415|bdfaa98c.text: I heard ol' Marshal McBride was sendin' ye' my way.

258930|4ef1d72e.name: Isaac Chan
258930|4ef1d72e.text: Ah friend, I only help hunters and their pets.

261|04c00651.name: Guard Thomas
261|04c00651.text: Hello, citizen.  You look like a woman with a purpose - do you have business with the Stormwind Army?

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

295|ed5e81b7.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|ed5e81b7.text:
What can you do at an inn?

Well when you stay at an inn, you rest very comfortably.  Because of this, you will become "well rested" much more quickly than you would in the wilderness.  When you are well rested, you learn more from experience.

You may also speak with any innkeeper to get a hearthstone, and can later use the hearthstone in order to quickly return to that inn.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

459|710d6c2c.name: Drusilla La Salle
459|710d6c2c.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Even if you do not follow the path of the $c, you would do well to remember that.

461|86b6c1ef.name: Demisette Cloyce
461|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

514|aa4da6d8.name: Smith Argus
514|aa4da6d8.text: If you'd like to learn how to blacksmith your own weapons and armor, I'd be happy to help.

5495|86b6c1ef.name: Ursula Deline
5495|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

5520|721fd095.name: Spackle Thornberry
5520|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

6373|721fd095.name: Dane Winslow
6373|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

6374|721fd095.name: Cylina Darkheart
6374|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

823|b02f6a36.name: Deputy Willem
823|b02f6a36.text: Hello there, $c.  Normally I'd be out on the beat looking after the folk of Stormwind, but a lot of the Stormwind guards are fighting in other lands.  So here I am, deputized and offering bounties when I'd rather be on patrol...

906|86b6c1ef.name: Maximillian Crowe
906|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

915|da74a3bd.name: Jorik Kerridan
915|da74a3bd.text: I don't think you want to learn anything I can teach. Might want to find a $c trainer to help you out.

963|f9eae059.name: Deputy Rainer
963|f9eae059.text:
I can't believe the officials in Stormwind, sending the bulk of our army abroad... when our home front is under so much pressure!

With thieves coming from Westfall and gnolls encroaching from from the east and west, it's a wonder Stormwind itself isn't besieged.

109-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
109-accept.text: Looks to me you've seen quite a bit of combat in your time, $c.  If you haven't already, you should report to Gryan Stoutmantle.  He heads up the People's Militia, aimed at protecting the farmlands of Westfall.  I bet he could use your help.  You can usually find him in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road in the middle of Westfall.
109-accept.title: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle

91741-accept.name: Unknown
91741-accept.text:
<One of the kobolds dropped this book. It looks like the kobold might have tried to eat it.

Brother Paxton inside the abbey has a small library he maintains. The book must have come from there.>
91741-accept.title: Nibbled-On Book

97924-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
97924-accept.text:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97924-accept.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97924-complete.name: Helene Peltskinner
97924-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97924-complete.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97924-progress.name: Helene Peltskinner
97924-progress.text: If you've got some skill, I can teach you a thing or two.
97924-progress.title: Camping 101: Skinning
